metadata.subject: United States--History--War of 1812
metadata.title: The Late War, Between the United States and Great Britain From June, 1812, to February, 1815. Written in the Ancient Historical Style.
metadata.creator: Hunt, Gilbert J.
metadata.description: A heroic account of the war between the United States and Great Britian written using a Biblical style. It features engraved portraits of General Andrew Jackson and Stephen Decatur after Gilbert Stuart. The flyleaf is inscribed "James J Requa/ March 19, 1824". Third edition, 233 pages.
